verdict.rationale: Wrangler is documented as the CLI for creating, developing and deploying Workers, which implies deploying from local files without a Git integration. The versions-and-deployments rollback docs suggest a version model, but nothing shows a new upload being held private until explicitly published. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of direct folder/asset upload without Git, documented upload-without-publish (private preview/staged version) workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
